title: This is so much smaller than it looked.
text: This is so much smaller than it looked.. The four branches were dropped into a small basket, nothing to hold them in place, I was very disappointed in the whole thing. Not worth the money!

product_metadata.title: AceList Artificial Sunflower Bouquets with Handmade Flower Basket, 4 Bunches Silk Sunflower Fake Sunflowers for Home Decoration Wedding Decor
features: 【A Delightful Package】You will get 4 artificial sunflower bouquets and a straw basket from the package. Each bunch contains 4 large faux flowers, 9 small fake flowers and 12 realistic green leaves. The size of each bunch is 10.5H*10W, the basket is 6H*5.5W, and the whole product is 12H*12W.

【Rustic Farmhouse Style】In vibrant yellow, our fake floral arrangement is bright and cheery, and just as warm and inviting as the sweet summer sun, which give your home a touch of nature while harkening back to the past. The woven basket coming with is also a key element to bring country flair into your living space.

【Fine Craftsmanship】The silk sunflower is made of quality fabric, incredibly vivid and lifelike from any distance. The stalk is made of plastic, non-toxic, scent-free and is easy to take care, simply wipe clean with damp cloth. The straw basket is woven around a sturdy metal frame to keep it standing still.

【A Gift of Sunshine】The sunflower bunches can be freely arranged as you see fit. The flower is not removable, but the bouquets and the woven basket can be separated freely. Great artificial flowers for graduation, perfect as home decoration, wedding decorations and table centerpiece for parties, bringing a burst of happy energy to everyone’s day.

【Aftersales Support】Due to the long-distance transportation, the product will have a little smell. Please take the product out to dissipate the smell before use. The basket is straw-woven, so we recommend you to place it in a well-ventilated and dry area. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us. We promise to make it right for you.
